purpose: D1 factorial: separate stuck-language from context-richness as the driver of skill invocation.
frozen: 2026-08-20, before any candidate description text was drafted

factors.context: situational detail + first-person stake + a tried-X clause. tried-X is classed as CONTEXT (a fact about the situation), not as stuck-language (a statement about the asker's state). This boundary is a judgment call and is the main threat to the factorial's cleanliness; it is recorded here rather than discovered later.
factors.stuck: an explicit statement of being out of ideas, or an explicit request for options

load_bearing: C. If C fires at rate comparable to B/D, the driver is context and no description rewrite reaches the problem.

kids.A: What should a parent do about kids forming attachments to AI companions?
kids.B: What should a parent do about kids forming attachments to AI companions? I'm out of ideas — what else could we try?
kids.C: My two kids, 9 and 13, have both started talking to an AI companion app every evening, and the younger one now prefers it to calling her friends. We've set screen-time limits and tried scheduling more in-person playdates, and neither has changed much. Their school has no policy on any of this. What should a parent do about it?
kids.D: My two kids, 9 and 13, have both started talking to an AI companion app every evening, and the younger one now prefers it to calling her friends. We've set screen-time limits and tried scheduling more in-person playdates, and neither has changed much. Their school has no policy on any of this. I'm out of ideas — what else could we try?

relationships.A: What will be the impact of AI and Robotics - and the rapid advancement in both - on human relationships?
relationships.B: What will be the impact of AI and Robotics - and the rapid advancement in both - on human relationships? I keep circling the same few answers and I'm out of angles — what else is there?
relationships.C: I've been asked to write the opening section of a long-range piece on how the next decade plays out, for readers who follow this closely. We've already worked through the obvious ground — companion apps substituting for friendship, automation freeing up time, synthetic media eroding trust in mediated contact — and it reads like everything else on the subject. What will be the impact of AI and robotics on human relationships?

design.detectable: 0/6 vs 4/6 -> Fisher p=0.06; 0/6 vs 5/6 -> p=0.015. Large cell differences only. Stated in advance.
design.environments: MUST run in both the harness (one plugin mounted) and a roster resembling the live session (many competing skills). The observed failures were live; the harness is not the same environment and a harness-only result does not transfer.
design.scoring: skillsInvoked AND evidence the pipeline ran (skillActivity>=1, toolCount, answer length). A load-then-decline is NOT scored as a fire.

note_on_content: Prompts are deliberately generic. No occupational, organisational or sector-specific detail belongs in this corpus — it is a public file.
